symptom: High bearing temperature and abnormal acoustic pitch
maintenance_action: Lubricated drive-end roller bearing and retorqued housing bolts
outcome: Resolved - Bearing temperature stabilized within nominal 65C operating limit

symptom: Recurrent harmonic vibration under peak load
maintenance_action: Replaced degraded elastomer coupling insert and re-aligned shaft
outcome: Resolved - Vibration velocity decreased from 7.2 mm/s to 1.4 mm/s

symptom: Intermittent pressure drop across primary hydraulic circuit
maintenance_action: Replaced clogged 10-micron hydraulic return filter cartridge and bled air
outcome: Resolved - System line pressure restored to stable 210 bar

symptom: Spindle positioning drift and optical encoder feedback error
maintenance_action: Cleaned linear glass scale with isopropyl alcohol and recalibrated zero datum
outcome: Resolved - Positioning repeatability verified within +/- 2 microns

symptom: Spindle drive thermal trip during high-torque milling cycles
maintenance_action: Flushed closed-loop glycol chiller circuit and replenished heat transfer fluid
outcome: Resolved - Coolant loop supply temp dropped by 8C; no subsequent thermal trips

maintenance_action: Inspected proportional solenoid valve and replaced worn rod wiper seal
outcome: Resolved - Cycle stroke time restored to standard 420 ms
